description: sum_first_n(nums, n) returns sum of first n elements
add_item(item, bucket=None) appends to a fresh list each call
safe_divide(a, b) raises ValueError not ZeroDivisionError on b=0
double_all(nums) returns new doubled list, does not mutate input
average(nums) rounds to 2dp, returns 0.0 on empty list
can_checkout(cart_items, is_logged_in) requires non-empty cart AND login
last_n(items, n) returns last n items in order, [] if n=0
